title: gVisor vs Firecracker summary with cited sources

turns.prompt: Research how gVisor and Firecracker differ as sandboxes for untrusted code. Write a 150-250 word summary to {D}/gvisor.md that cites at least three source URLs (put the URLs in the file). Tell me when it is done.
turns.verify: f={D}/gvisor.md; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no gvisor.md; exit 0; }; w=$(wc -w < $f); u=$(grep -oE 'https?://[^ )>]+' $f | sort -u | wc -l); echo "SHOW words=$w urls=$u"; sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f | head -60; if [ $w -ge 120 ] && [ $w -le 400 ] && [ $u -ge 3 ]; then echo PASS; else echo "FAIL: words=$w urls=$u"; fi

rubric.criteria: Accurate contrast (gVisor = user-space kernel/syscall interception, no KVM needed; Firecracker = microVM with KVM, stronger isolation, needs virtualization). Cites real sources. Clear prose.
